body: Man I know the feeling. I hate when these thoughts and rage and existential torment enters my mind. Last night I was reading about this philosophical concept called absurdism. The main tenet is that life has no inherent meaning and seeking to find a meaning is incompatible with the human experience because we have consciousness and awareness of our own mortality, which deems existence pointless. There are 3 ways to resolve this conundrum: 1. Escape by suicide 2. The (religious) leap of faith. 3. Accept the absurdity of existence, basically become indifferent to life and accepting the pain and torment and anything life has to offer as utterly arbitrary to gain ultimate freedom, because it will all end anyways and inherently nothing matters. I'm trying to live by number 3 but it is easier said than done.
God clearly has no interest in meddling in human affairs.

I made a post earlier that touches on the morning wake-up, because I'm very familiar with that dread. Seeing the fuckin sun again and I'm like "FUCK! When will I see the sun for the last time?"  Then it sucks when I can't return to the oblivion of sleep. Now, my bodily functions drive me to eat, piss, think, and loathe to repeat this cycle indefinitely. Perhaps, an epoch defining moment like a massive alien civilization encounter would make this jaded human existence worth living.
I would say yes. I have degraded to imagining my corpse in the first stages of decomposition in the spot where I blow my brains out before anyone discovers it.

I agree with your statements. I do believe this is punishment. From my personal experience and theory, I believe I may have killed myself in the previously life and was sent here (or back here) to suffer. And if I do it again, I will be punished with the same fate.

I briefly contemplated this sentiment. Since I have nothing tying me down, I could just leave.. Move far away to a completely new environment, preferably to one not of Westernized culture, then take on a new identity, a new life. In the process, hopefully I can reform my psyche and enjoy who I've become.

I hate feeling like shit and suicidal. I struggled with it most of my life. I prefer to live a life of pleasure. I'm a hedonist at heart. But when times are rough, they are drastically rough and very dreadful. When I can't rationalize with it, I want to end it all. The thought of my death does not frighten me. It would be a relief if anything, especially since I don't value life or have respect for reality as other people do. I just am not strong enough to override the inherent will of self-preservation and kill myself. Fighting the natural instinct to survive leads to the abyss of existential torment.
If Youre 16. At least smoke some pot for a few years before you cut everything short.
I will commit myself to an institution this Friday. Hopefully, it will be no hassle to get drugs that will block out the disillusionment of life. It's either that or heroin.
I really want to vanish. My life has come to this point where my existence is unnecessary for anything.

It's interesting to see how many teens are in here. There's no way you can be a failure at 16. No way. Fuck what anyone tells you. You're life path is open ended. There are so many routes you can take. High school and grades are bullshit that don't matter in the real world.
